The exact square-path decay kernel yields a nontrivial strict sign for every pair of positive-weight crossing/energy statistics and an explicit n-dependent AR(1) law, not merely a marginal moment or selected numeric evaluation. The positive-definite, all-positive-correlation three-variable counterexample proves that the tree hypothesis is structurally consequential.
